parameters.ordering: sequential; no warm-up or retries; all 20 attempts retained
parameters.acceptance: All 20 must have four passing baselines <=2s, exactly 10 planned and completed mutants, complete observed loss, and p95 <=120s
parameters.timed_scope: make_plan plus compare, including Git reads, target provenance, four baseline suites, actual Cosmic Ray generation, repeat pairs, and final original-source controls
parameters.excluded_setup: dependency installation, Git fixture creation, wheel build, and evidence serialization

mutation_provider: Actual Cosmic Ray generation via generate_bounded; no overrides
fixture_origin: Original testdelta.cli.demo pricing source and strong tests; only its four equality assertions changed to >= 0
limitations: One synthetic four-test fixture on one local host; no general workload claim
Other local tests/corpus work ran concurrently; host load was uncontrolled
